blocks.text:
read this before
your day starts:
"you're not behind. you're on a road nobody has walked before, so nobody gets to time you."

caption:
Nobody gets to time your journey. ☕🖤
What's one thing you're doing at your own pace right now? 👇
Send this to the friend who keeps comparing herself.

#morningreminder #youarenotbehind #selfgrowth #comparisonisthethiefofjoy #slowliving #soselfcoded
